protocol.selection: Best mean ADD among the measured initial reference and completed eligible agent trials at each time. Equal task weights.
protocol.missingness: All 40 tasks begin at the measured initial-reference execution at minute zero. Until the first completed eligible trial, the initial-reference value is retained. Five longer Codex runs have no eligible saved trial by 30 minutes. No later trial is backdated and no zero errors are imputed.
protocol.clock: Elapsed active refinement minutes, using trial completion times.
protocol.semantic: Final judgments from separate 30- and 120-minute runs. Not within-run transitions or first-pass times.
protocol.final_selection: The curve retains the best available ADD, including the initial reference; final submitted executions can differ.
